title: JSW Cement commissions two capacity expansion projects
summary: JSW Cement commissions two capacity expansion projects
body_markdown:
**India:** JSW Cement has approved two capacity expansion projects involving a combined investment of US$113m. At its Vijayanagar plant in Karnataka, the company will install a ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBS) grinding system with a capacity of 2Mt/yr. The project will cost US$53m.


At its Dolvi facility in Maharashtra, the company will establish an additional cement grinding mill with a capacity of 2Mt/yr. Commissioning is expected by October 2028.
